title: I have a tinfoil theory about The Substance (2024)

commenti.body:
The Substance isn't real in the same sense that his character is real. The Substance is a concept of the self, and as a concept, it's created by all of us within our psychology. We do it ourselves already—it's just a visual representation of what we do. In a sense, when she goes to the alleyway, she's reaching into her own psyche, not traveling to an actual physical location. 

Plus he's simply not clever or smart enough, even if you want to think of it as external for a moment.

I am in agreement with this statement. 

If there is any hidden meaning to the Harvey character, it is not extremely deep, or well hidden, and, in fact, lives on the surface. 

It's in his name. Which reminds us of a certain producer...
